decision.title: Live
tracklist: L'Amour de Ma Vie / Over Now (Extended)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (27 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft:_The_Tour_(Live), https://www.discogs.com/release/37108080-Billie-Eilish-Hit-Me-Hard-And-Soft-The-Tour-Live. Official title is 'Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live)' (stylized all caps). Second live album, released May 1, 2026 via Darkroom/Interscope. Recorded July 19-23, 2025 at Co-op Live, Manchester. 3LP one-time recycled-vinyl pressing. Medley tracks: 'NDA / Therefore I Am' and 'L'Amour de Ma Vie / Over Now (Extended)'. The DB title 'Live' should be renamed to the official title.
